name: AMD Radeon Cloud
description: AMD's free public model API for development, evaluation and hackathons.
overview: AMD Radeon Cloud exposes a free model API for development, evaluation, demos, hackathons and open-source work: DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8 Flash/27B, GLM-5.3 Flash, MiMo-V2.6 Flash, MiniCPM5 and MinerU. Prompts and outputs roll off after two days and are never used for training, but content is logged in ordinary operation, and a rolling 24-hour spend ceiling (unpublished) gates heavy use.
free_access: Free route for development, evaluation and open-source work
9 models including DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8 and GLM-5.3 Flash
30 RPM per key, 120 RPM per IP, 8 concurrent requests
No card required; automatic API key on registration
notes: A rolling 24-hour spend cap (value unpublished) limits heavy usage; prompts are kept for two days.
